troubleshooting_and_exception_handling: If parameter deviation or defect occurs, immediately halt workstation operations, tag the non-conforming workpiece, and transfer it to the designated Red-Box quarantine station. Perform a 5-Why root cause audit on tool zeroing, operator technique, and incoming component lots before resetting the workstation interlocks.
Log non-conformance ID and quarantine affected workpiece to containment station.
If 2 consecutive units drift beyond upper tolerance limits, trigger immediate line stop.

workstations.executive_workstation_scope: Standard Operating Procedure WS-020 establishes controlled industrial execution parameters for Maintaining personalprotection andpreventing thetransmission ofinfections fromperson to person under ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.1. The workstation enforces a target cycle time of 240 seconds within a plant takt time of 300 seconds, balancing shopfloor takt cadence and preventing downstream line starvation.
workstations.engineering_principles_and_science: Execution parameters are governed by industrial tolerances and safety thresholds specific to the Healthcare domain. Standardized work sequences prevent process drift, material fatigue, and thermal/mechanical deformation. Verification gates ensure all measured values conform strictly within nominal limits prior to release to the subsequent workstation.
